Description
Sprout Social is looking to hire a GTM AI Engineer to the Sales & Customer Experience team.
You’ll build and ship the AI agents, automations and integrations that take admin work off our reps and managers and help our revenue teams sell, forecast and renew with more insight. You’ll sit in GTM Systems & Applied AI, work inside our AI Center of Excellence for GTM, and partner closely with Salesforce IT and the business teams who use what you build.
Why join Sprout’s Revenue Operations, Sales & Customer Experience team?
At Sprout Social, our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.
As the strategic engine of our go-to-market organization, Revenue Operations builds the infrastructure that turns data into action. We specialize in architecting world-class processes and delivering the operational clarity that allows our teams to move with speed, anticipate market shifts, and optimize the entire customer lifecycle for sustainable growth.
In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.
What you’ll do
Design, build and ship AI agents, automations and integrations for Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Deal Desk and Revenue Operations, taking them from prototype to production.
Turn priority use cases from the GTM AI roadmap into working solutions with clear adoption and impact measures, starting with the ones that cut rep admin time.
Integrate AI solutions with Salesforce, Gong and other GTM systems, working with Salesforce IT on architecture, security and the release process.
Build evaluation, monitoring and guardrails so AI outputs are accurate, auditable and safe to use in revenue workflows.
Partner with the Business Analyst on requirements, test scenarios and UAT, and with Sales Enablement on rollout and adoption.
Contribute to AI Center of Excellence governance: technical standards, documentation, data access, and build-versus-buy reviews of tools and vendors.
Identify data quality and process gaps that limit AI performance, and help close them with RevOps and Salesforce IT.
Stay current on a fast-moving field, use AI coding tools in your own work, and share what works with the team.
What you’ll bring
You’re an engineer who ships. You’re comfortable owning a problem from idea through production, you care about whether AI outputs are actually right, and you can explain tradeoffs clearly to non-technical leaders.
The minimum qualifications for this role include:
3+ years of experience in software engineering, data or machine learning engineering, or applied AI, including shipping production software.
Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications: prompting, tool or function calling, retrieval, agents and evaluation.
Strong programming skills (Python or similar) and experience building APIs and system integrations.
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to scope problems and deliver solutions independently.
Sound judgment on data security, privacy and access control when AI touches customer and revenue data.
Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Preferred qualifications for this role include:
Experience integrating with Salesforce (APIs, Apex or flows) or a strong understanding of CRM data models.
Experience working with Gong or other conversation intelligence data.
Experience in a sales, revenue operations or go-to-market environment.
Experience with agent or workflow automation frameworks and AI evaluation tooling.
Experience evaluating build-versus-buy decisions for AI tools.
How you’ll grow
Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:
Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
Make a plan with your manager to set initial priorities, align on expectations for your role, plant goalposts for your career, and learn about Sprout’s approach to building and governing AI for go-to-market teams.
Learn our GTM stack, the Salesforce and Gong data available to build on, and how Salesforce IT handles security and releases.
Ship a small prototype or quick win with a pilot group.
Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:
Build connections with members from other teams through active networking and community building.
Ship your first AI solution to a pilot group with defined success measures.
Set up the evaluation and monitoring approach for your solutions with the Director of GTM Systems & Applied AI.
Agree on integration and security patterns with Salesforce IT.
Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:
Have your first performance conversation with your manager, where you’ll discuss your accomplishments in your role and work together to build goals for your professional growth.
Move at least one solution into production at scale, with adoption and impact measured.
Contribute to the AI Center of Excellence standards and documentation.
Work with the Business Analyst to make requirements and UAT part of every AI release.
Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:
Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change your team in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet.
Own a portfolio of AI use cases from roadmap through adoption, with a clear record of time saved or revenue impact.
Shape build-versus-buy decisions for GTM AI tools.
Raise the technical bar for the team through standards, reusable components and shared practices.
Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.
Our Benefits Program
We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:
Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line .
* This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

**Who We Are**
At Domino, we build solutions that help the largest, highly regulated organizations adopt AI to accelerate mission-critical use cases. Our platform integrates a streamlined model and app development environment, advanced model, agent, and app hosting capabilities, and novel governance capabilities providing regulator-ready AI at scale. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for over a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. In the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai
  
  
**What Your Impact Will Be**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer Intern at Domino, you’ll spend 10 weeks working directly with our customers and teams to help them realize value from the Domino platform. Unlike traditional engineering internships, FDE interns blend software engineering skills with customer empathy and domain awareness.
  
  
Throughout your internship, you’ll get hands-on experience writing code, designing solutions, and supporting real-world, high-stakes environments spanning healthcare, life sciences, finance, government, and beyond.
  
  
At Domino, we believe in giving interns opportunities to contribute to impactful and visible projects from the start. You’ll gain mentorship, practical experience, and a strong understanding of what it means to be an FDE, all while making a meaningful contribution to our customers and teams.
  
  
**What We Look For In This Role**

* “Act fast, own it” mentality: We move fast, and need people who are driven, motivated, and bold.
* Passion for AI/data engineering, software engineering, large language models, and real world applications
* Proficiency in Python is required, additional experience with R, Java, or C/C++ is a plus
* Exposure to building applied AI systems such as RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, or model evaluation, through coursework, internships, or personal projects
* Comfort picking up container concepts such as Docker and Kubernetes, and basic familiarity with a cloud provider such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Strong communication and problem solving skills, with an interest in customer facing work
* Graduating in Spring 2028, pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field

**What We Value**

* We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply
* We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success
* We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work
* We value all of you that believe improving is always possible. At Domino, everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything
* We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company

**WHAT IS BOX?**
Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.
  
  
By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.
  
  
**WHY BOX NEEDS YOU**
Box’s Edge (Network Platform Engineering) team powers the connectivity behind our products, including Box Zones and applications hosted across our environment. We’re evolving from a ticket-driven support model to building automated, self-serve network capabilities that application and service owners can consume reliably at scale. We’re looking for a Software Engineer III to design and build backend services and automation that turn complex network functionality into simple, safe, and repeatable workflows. In this role, you’ll deliver high-impact systems using Python and Terraform, grounded in strong networking fundamentals. You’ll partner with internal customers to transform recurring requests into robust products, improving delivery speed, reliability, and developer experience across Box.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and implement backend services and tooling in Python that make network capabilities accessible for internal application and service owners.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code with Terraform to provision, configure, and manage network resources reliably.
* Translate partner needs into automated workflows that replace manual, ticket-based processes and scale across teams.
* Participate in design reviews, question assumptions thoughtfully, and contribute to decisions that improve reliability, security, and usability.
* Integrate observability and guardrails to support safe, auditable, and measurable network changes.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (application owners, reliability, platform) to define requirements and deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Write tests, documentation, and runbooks to support operational excellence and maintainability.
* Contribute to roadmap planning and continuous improvement of network automation patterns and standards.
* Participate in our on-call rotation, available at all times while on-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise.

**Who You Are**
We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.
  
  

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong backend focus.
* Proficient in Python with a track record of building production-grade services or automation.
* Hands-on with Infrastructure as Code, especially Terraform, including module design, reviews, and CI/CD integration.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (e.g., TCP/IP, routing vs. switching concepts, DNS, load balancing, security groups/firewalls).
* Product mindset: you distill complex systems into safe, reusable abstractions and prioritize user experience for internal customers.
* Systems thinker who can break down ambiguous problems, propose pragmatic designs, and measure outcomes.
* Collaborative communicator who seeks diverse perspectives, builds alignment, and gives and receives feedback constructively.
* Nice to have: Experience with cloud platforms (GCP and/or AWS), service-to-service networking, and network automation tooling.
* Nice to have: Familiarity with observability platforms (e.g., Infroscope or similar), testing frameworks, and secure-by-default practices.
